row.notes: U-level DEVELOPMENT start (formerly Car_Apply_UpgradeToVehicle, car lane; renamed per ce-verify-1 V0238): if inst+0x7c==0xff stores the enabled index at +0xa8 and 0x14351df60(upgrades,owner,inst,0) at +0xa4; failure roll only when roll_failure and latest state != Failed; pushes InDevelopment (7) with +0x98/+0x9a start/end and +0xa0 fail; end==start clears +0xa0 and pushes PendingFitting (8) only when DAT_1460fc310==2 (otherwise it stays InDevelopment); dual==1 in upgrades+8==2 mode mirrors to the same-id instances of the other owners; then fitted-ratio post if Completed / 0x143530430 if PendingFitting, availability refresh, upgrades-changed message. Callers 0x141242530, 0x1412447b0, Car_Fit_UpgradesToRating 0x143514670, 0x14352f060

verify.notes: V0307 Independent: frame 8 pushes+0x18f8 so [rsp+0x1960..0x1988] = end u16, option u8, dual u8, roll u8, rng, store u8; r9 used as 16-bit (bp). inst+0x7c==0xff -> +0xa8 enabled index, +0xa4 = 0x14351df60(u,owner,inst,0); Push(7), +0x98/+0x9a/+0xa0; end==start clears +0xa0 and pushes 8 only when lifecycle==2; dual==1 && upgrades+8==2 mirror; fitted post on 3, 0x143530430 on 8, refresh/+0x1aa8, bus msg; callers exactly the four listed. Wording note: the failure roll also requires inst+0x7c==0xff (cmp at 0x1435174e1), not only roll_failure and latest != Failed.
